{{Top|leg}}
'''Outpost Freedom''' was an outpost located near [[Bugtown]], the former Farnel Research Facility. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] sought to build their own base there, but the presence of [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] in the area prevented any progress.
